cards.title: Define the full project specification
cards.body: Foundation — Establish CSVX as an implementation-independent, specification-first spreadsheet format. Labels: specification, architecture.

cards.title: Write the normative Core 1.0 specification
cards.body: Foundation — Document the container, workbook, sheets, types, values, formulas, functions, styles, validation, calculation, import/export, security, and conformance requirements. Labels: specification.

cards.title: Align the package around CSV as the data layer
cards.body: Foundation — Use sheets/<sheet-id>.csv as canonical tabular data with optional matching .meta.json sidecars for formulas, caches, types, styles, validation, and overrides. Labels: format, decision.

cards.title: Add and align JSON Schemas
cards.body: Foundation — Keep manifest, workbook, styles, and formula schemas consistent with CSV-backed sheets and typed values. Labels: schemas.

cards.title: Create reviewable examples and initial conformance vectors
cards.body: Foundation — Provide minimal, typed, formula, multi-sheet, styled, parsing, calculation, style-preservation, and invalid fixtures. Labels: examples, testing.

cards.title: Add the CSVX AI skill
cards.body: Foundation — Document how AI tools should inspect the specification, preserve metadata, handle formulas, validate changes, and report assumptions. Labels: ai, developer-experience.

cards.title: Phase 1: Implement CSVX package and data model
cards.body: Phase 1 — Build the Go package reader/writer, manifest loading, workbook loading, sheet loading, typed values, sparse metadata, and round-trip preservation. Labels: go, engine, phase-1.

cards.title: Load CSVX ZIP packages
cards.body: Phase 1 — Read manifest.json, workbook.json, CSV sheets, and optional metadata sidecars; reject duplicate and unsafe ZIP entries. Labels: go, package.

cards.title: Load unpacked CSVX directories
cards.body: Phase 1 — Support development-friendly inspection of unpacked CSVX fixtures. Labels: go, package.

cards.title: Add initial CSVX CLI
cards.body: Phase 1 — Provide inspect, validate, version, help, and package commands with useful command-specific help. Labels: go, cli.

cards.title: Implement canonical CSVX package writing
cards.body: Phase 1 — Write valid CSVX ZIP packages from the canonical workbook model with deterministic resource paths and metadata. Labels: go, package, phase-1.

cards.title: Complete Phase 1 validation and round-trip tests
cards.body: Phase 1 — Validate schemas, required resources, CSV/header rules, sidecar identity, unknown metadata preservation, and directory-to-package round trips. Labels: testing, phase-1.

cards.title: Phase 2: Implement the formula MVP
cards.body: Phase 2 — Add literals, cell references, ranges, arithmetic, comparisons, percent, and Core functions SUM, COUNT, IF, ROUND, and ABS. Labels: formula, phase-2.

cards.title: Specify and test formula grammar
cards.body: Phase 2 — Define tokenization, precedence, string and boolean literals, sheet references, quoted sheet names, ranges, and invalid syntax behavior. Labels: formula, specification.

cards.title: Implement Core formula functions
cards.body: Phase 2 — Implement SUM, COUNT, IF, ROUND, and ABS with explicit blank, string, type, and error semantics. Labels: formula, calculation.

cards.title: Phase 3: Implement deterministic calculation
cards.body: Phase 3 — Build dependency graphs, deterministic evaluation, stale cache invalidation, calculation ordering, and portable errors. Labels: calculation, phase-3.

cards.title: Build formula dependency graph
cards.body: Phase 3 — Track direct and transitive dependencies across cells and sheets, and invalidate only affected formula caches. Labels: calculation.

cards.title: Implement portable calculation errors
cards.body: Phase 3 — Produce CYCLE, DIV0, VALUE, REF, and NAME errors according to the normative semantics. Labels: calculation, errors.

cards.title: Phase 4: Build the executable conformance suite
cards.body: Phase 4 — Create an implementation-independent runner for valid, invalid, formula, calculation, and round-trip CSVX fixtures. Labels: testing, conformance, phase-4.

cards.title: Generate real .csvx fixture archives
cards.body: Phase 4 — Package the unpacked examples into valid ZIP fixtures and add invalid archive cases. Labels: testing, fixtures.

cards.title: Implement CSV import and export
cards.body: Post-Core — Define and implement loss-aware conversion between standalone CSV files and the CSVX workbook model. Labels: import, export.

cards.title: Implement XLSX import and export
cards.body: Post-Core — Translate XLSX through the canonical CSVX workbook model with documented unsupported-feature behavior. Labels: import, export, xlsx.

cards.title: Complete CLI operations
cards.body: Post-Core — Add recalculate, conversion, structured diagnostics, output selection, and machine-readable modes. Labels: cli.

cards.title: Integrate the engine with Coder
cards.body: Post-Core — Expose CSVX through a UI without leaking Coder-specific behavior into the format or engine. Labels: coder, integration.

cards.title: Enable independent language implementations
cards.body: Post-Core — Use the specification, schemas, fixtures, and conformance suite to support Rust, Python, TypeScript, and other engines. Labels: ecosystem, conformance.
